verdict.rationale: Ramp explicitly documents Google Maps-based automatic mileage calculation for reimbursements (ramp-docs-15) and automatic per-diem rates that adjust by trip location/duration (ramp-docs-19), directly matching the story's two core capabilities without manual expense building. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the employee-facing mileage entry flow and more detail on how per-diem claims are submitted end-to-end.
